title: refactor: move Z-Image GPU backend under operations
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves the active Z-Image worker from image.pollinations.ai/z-image to operations/infrastructure/gpu/zimage.
- Updates Vast, IO.NET, Docker entrypoint, fleet inventory, and monitoring references for the new path.
- Changes no model behavior, routing, credentials, pricing, or live Vast instances.

Operational note:
- Existing Z-Image workers keep running their currently checked-out files.
- Do not pull this commit into an existing worker checkout by itself: /root/run-zimage.sh points at the old path.
- On a future reprovision or intentional worker update, run setup-vast.sh from the new path so it rewrites the restart command before relying on the new checkout.

Validation:
- operations deployment-detection tests
- shell syntax checks for every moved script
- Python compilation checks
- stale-path and relative-link checks
- git diff --check

Stacked on #13241.

gist.headline: Z-Image found its shed
gist.blurb: The Z-Image GPU worker packed its Dockerfiles, scripts, and monitoring notes into the operations garden. The bees kept making pixels while the tool shed got tidier.
gist.summary: Moved the active Z-Image GPU worker stack from image.pollinations.ai/z-image to operations/infrastructure/gpu/zimage, updating Vast, IO.NET, Docker entrypoint, fleet inventory, and monitoring references without changing live model behavior or routing.
gist.impact: Current Z-Image workers continue running unchanged, while future Vast or IO.NET reprovisions can use the consolidated operations path and its updated setup scripts.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy operations garden shed represents the new infrastructure home for the Z-Image worker: Polli carefully carries a small glowing image-server crate along a garden path toward a labeled GPU tool shed, while a friendly CRT monitor robot checks a deployment map. Code-plants and small GPU crates make the move feel organized rather than disruptive.
